title: NullTok: empirical-null token selection for training-free long video understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.23881v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long video understanding remains a daunting challenge for existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs), mainly due to the large number of visual tokens accumulated in long videos. Currently, frame selection and token selection are two main paradigms for addressing this issue, both aiming to select relevant visual information to form a compact input for MLLMs. A natural approach combines these two paradigms by selecting frames before pruning tokens, but noisy frame-level relevance estimates can cause irreversible evidence loss. In this paper, we study this problem from the perspective of assessing the spatiotemporal distribution of query-specific evidence and propose a novel and training-free approach termed NULLTOK. For every patch across all frames, we construct an empirical-null distribution from 64 group-matched irrelevant control queries, capturing the scores expected in the absence of target-specific evidence. translated_title: NullTok：面向免训练长视频理解的经验零假设标记选择
translated_abstract: 长视频理解对现有多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）而言仍是一项艰巨的挑战，主要原因在于长视频中累积了大量视觉标记。目前，帧选择与标记选择是解决该问题的两种主要范式，二者都旨在选取相关的视觉信息，以构成紧凑的模型输入。一种自然的做法是将这两种范式结合，即先选帧再剪枝标记，但帧级相关性估计中的噪声可能导致不可逆的证据丢失。本文从评估查询特定证据的时空分布这一角度研究该问题，提出了一种新颖的免训练方法 NullTok。对于所有帧中的每个图像块（patch），我们基于 64 个组匹配的无关对照查询构建经验零假设分布，用以刻画在缺乏目标特定证据情况下所预期的分数，并据此衡量目标亲和力……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出免训练方法 NullTok，通过为每个图像块基于 64 个组匹配的无关对照查询构建经验零假设分布，来评估查询特定证据的时空分布，从而在长视频理解的标记选择中避免帧级噪声导致的证据丢失。
en_tdlr: NullTok is a training-free token selection method that constructs an empirical-null distribution from 64 group-matched irrelevant control queries for every patch to assess the spatiotemporal distribution of query-specific evidence, avoiding irreversible evidence loss in long video understanding.
